# ZeroDriveX Data Intelligence Platform

> A real-data-first platform for preparing AI training and evaluation datasets with verified provenance, quality analysis, governed synthetic augmentation and audit-ready exports.

## Core capabilities

- Ingest CSV, JSON and JSONL datasets with source and licence provenance
- Distinguish verified authentic, unverified and synthetic records
- Analyse datasets, infer schemas for review, evaluate quality and manage repair cases
- Add controlled synthetic data while enforcing a maximum 30% synthetic share in the final dataset
- Block training exports unless at least 70% of the final dataset is verified authentic
- Run durable dataset jobs and export data with an audit-ready manifest

## Access model

- The homepage is public.
- Dashboards, settings and tenant data require sign-in.
- Operator administration is separate and requires its own authenticated, MFA-gated session.
